text:
Asset managers — sector note (draft, public data only)

1. Flows: listed active managers saw net outflows for a third straight quarter. Passive and systematic products keep taking share.
2. Valuation: listed alternative managers trade at 9x to 12x forward earnings; traditional long-only managers at 8x to 10x.
3. Taylor Mason Capital trades at about 8.6x 2027 consensus earnings of $4.80, the low end of its alternatives peers, after Q3's 3% fall in AUM.
4. Fee pressure: average management fees across the group are down about 4 basis points year over year.

To do: refresh the peer table with Friday's closes; the note goes out monthly, next edition due Oct 30.
